answer: Seed-vault attestation ties each identity to a seed vault. On signup, the applicant files a seed-curation certificate earned by exam and a supervised cataloguing season, checked with the agricultural registry, one certificate per vault. Each epoch the curator logs one vine seed accession sent for germination testing, verified by its cipher lock and beacon light. Forging 100 identities needs 100 certificates at $390 each, $39,000 in total.
